newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Bund vol steady as February due to expire.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Bund vol steady as February due to expire.

text.p: Implied volatility levels of options on Bund futures traded on LIFFE held steady on Wednesday amid plenty of activity as players rolled over their positions from the front month, traders said.
February serial options on the March future are due to expire on Friday, making March the front month.
"Volatility hasn't moved much today at all, we are more or less where we opened," said a broker at a European bank in London. "Most of the activity had been at the front end."
Traders quoted implied volatility for March options on Bunds at 5.85/6.0 percent compared with a mid-vol level of of 6.03 percent late Tuesday.
In the back months, vol was trading at 5.55/5.75 percent for April and at 5.85/5.95 percent for June compared with 5.92 percent and 5.87 percent respectively, on Tuesday.
"We've seen volatility ranging between 5.50 to just over 6.0 percent recently, it is probably worth selling vol here," the broker said.
The market was still trying to interpret U.S. Federal Chairman Alan Greenspan's comments on Tuesday and wether they would lead to a possible interest rate rise in early February or not, traders said.
"It seems like the market is slowly coming to terms with a rate hike later in the year, so from that perspective I would be selling vol," the European bank broker said.
Traders said the bulk of this session's activity had been in the front months.
According to LIFFE data, almost 10,000 lots of February 102.00 calls and around 15,000 lots of March 103.00 calls had been traded by 1315 GMT.
Brokers said a European bank had been short of 102.00 calls in February and was buying them back and selling the 103.00 calls. They also noted outright selling of the February 101.50 strike.
There was also some put buying and put spread trades as players sought protection to the downside, they said.
The underlying March Bund future was trading at 101.66, up 22 basis points on the day but off 101.92, the day's high made earlier in the session.
